description: Window-chrome grants shared by every Rekindle window. Only the exact core commands the frontend uses are granted: titlebar minimize/hide/close/toggle-maximize (`src/actions/titlebar.actions.ts`, `MenuBar.tsx`) and the two commands Tauri's `data-tauri-drag-region` handler invokes (start_dragging, internal_toggle_maximize). No `core:default`, no webview creation (windows are created only by Rust in `src/windows/`), no `core:event` (events arrive on each window's own channel from `subscribe_events`), and no plugin `*:default` bundles; plugin grants live in the per-window `app-*.json` files next to the commands that window may call. Enforced by `tests/capability_policy.rs`.
